newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITIMPEKS BANK BACK ON THE BOURSE.
newsitem.headline: LITIMPEKS BANK BACK ON THE BOURSE.

text.p: Lithuania's stock exchange said on Monday that it had okayed the resumption of trade in Litimpeks Bank's shares after the bank reduced the nominal value of its shares ten times.
The stock exchange said in a statement that Litimpeks Bank's shares worth 4.09 million litas will be traded from May 13.
Litimpeks decided earlier this year to devalue its share capital to 4.09 million litas and to issue a new 60 million litas share capital issue in a bid to attract foreign investors.
Litimpeks was unexpectedly shut by the central bank in December 1995 and was reopened last July.
It has pinned its hopes on the 60 million litas share issue and is currently in talks with several foreign banks.
The bank reported earlier that its losses in 1996 were 6.37 million litas and 1.9 million litas for the first three months of 1997.
